SENTINELS: the .do recodes 8 (N.S.) and 9 (N.C.) to missing; dropped per item (8/9): p1301 151/26, p1302 89/12, p1303 199/24, p1304 233/26, p1305 259/40 (4.1-12.1% of 2470 per item); 26 records answered no item and are absent (2444 ids). Live item x resp (1 Sí / 2 No): p1301 1974/319, p1302 2197/172, p1303 1700/547, p1304 1547/664, p1305 1796/375. Coherence (not needed for the exemption, consistent with it): the two voting items correlate 0.88 (p1303-p1304), far above every other pair (0.34-0.67), and general-election voting is the least endorsed right (70% Sí) after municipal voting (76%). STEP 3b: dictionary Description ('bring their family, receive unemployment benefit, vote in municipal and general elections and obtain Spanish nationality') matches the five P.13 rows one-for-one and the .do header reads 'rights (P1301 to P1305)'; 5 items and resp 1..2 match. P.13 is the only Sí/No block of five in the questionnaire around it (P.12 is a single categorical item, P.14 a 4-point agreement block), so no confusion. validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (5 items, resp sets exact). language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation (CIS publishes Estudio 3119 in Spanish only; the _translated columns are English written by IRW; 'Cobrar el subsidio si se quedan parados' rendered 'Receive unemployment benefit if they become unemployed'; issues-page line owed once live). note: mapping_basis=data_labels. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2015_immigration.do infixes DA3119 at p2501 113 .. p2508 120, identical to ES3119 DATA LIST lines 9-10 (P2501 113 .. P2508 120) and to the questionnaire's column markers (113)-(120) on each P.25 row; Bookmark 10 sets item = the lower-case CIS variable name -- nothing positional, Step 5b exempt, no verification_/verify_ files written. LABELS vs QUESTIONNAIRE (checked for a batch_506-style swap; none here): ES3119 VARIABLE LABELS lines 95-102 (/P2501../P2508) agree in order with the questionnaire rows at columns 113-120, 8/8 by referent, and are string-identical to the shipped item_text for 7/8 (asserted in .cache/spain_2015_immigration_roma/build.R). The one wording difference: /P2501 reads 'Vivir en el mismo barrio en el que viven personas gitanas' while the questionnaire row (col 113) reads '...viven muchas personas gitanas'; item_text ships the administered questionnaire wording WITH 'muchas' (it also parallels P.24's 'muchos inmigrantes', whose SPSS label keeps 'muchos'). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): item_text = the cues3119.pdf P.25 grid rows, line wraps rejoined ('ba-rrio', 'blo que'), leading bullet dash and dot leaders dropped, each asserted against pdftotext -raw output with its column marker. instructions = the P.25 stem verbatim, 'P.25' number dropped: 'Y, en cuanto a relacionarse con personas gitanas, dígame si acepta o aceptaría, trataría de evitar o rechazaría…' -- the trailing ellipsis (U+2026) is the questionnaire's own (the stem is completed by each read-out row), kept; asserted as exact substring. P.25 has no show card or other interviewer direction. One stem for all eight rows, so it sits in instructions; section_prompt blank; one trivial section_id. OPTIONS: ES3119 VALUE LABELS identical on P2501-P2508: 1 'Acepta/ría' 2 'Trataría de evitarla' 3 'Rechazaría' 4 '(NO LEER) Depende' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.' (asserted per item); the questionnaire grid header prints 'Acep-ta/ría', 'Trataría de evitarla', 'Recha-zaría'; option_text ships the value labels verbatim for resp 1-3, same as the P.24 sibling _distance. Direction: 1 = accept .. 3 = reject, as CIS codes it. SENTINELS: the .do recodes 4 ((NO LEER) Depende, volunteered, off-scale), 8 and 9 to missing; dropped per item (4/8/9): p2501 128/27/3, p2502 135/23/7, p2503 196/45/10, p2504 113/38/8, p2505 160/49/6, p2506 222/47/6, p2507 236/59/10, p2508 140/46/8 (6.4-12.3% of 2470 per item); 43 records answered no item and are absent (2427 ids). REBUILD, decisive: reading DA3119 (2470 records, width 320; id = row number) at cols 113-120, dropping 4/8/9 as the .do does, with cov_sex col 164 and cov_age cols 165-166 (99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 18038 rows both, 2427 ids both, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt id-item-resp keys, 0 cov_age mismatches; cov_sex Hombre 8795 / Mujer 9243 rows, no cross cells (.cache/spain_2015_immigration_roma/rebuild.R; live read from the local irw cache populated by table_context.R, no extra export). Live item x resp (1/2/3): p2501 931/864/517, p2502 914/856/535, p2503 718/636/865, p2504 1540/478/293, p2505 1514/432/309, p2506 1326/533/336, p2507 986/674/505, p2508 1136/705/435; means 1.82/1.84/2.07/1.46/1.47/1.55/1.78/1.69 -- every item uses all three levels. Content-coherent: the two residence items (p2501 neighbourhood, p2502 building) intercorrelate highest (r=0.89), the two work items (p2504 work/study with, p2505 boss) next (0.83), and renting a flat (p2503) is the most rejected (865 'Rechazaría'), as in P.24. STEP 3b: dictionary Description ('Acceptance, avoidance or rejection of eight situations of contact with Roma people (neighbourhood, building, renting, work, boss, child's friends, child's marriage, school)') and the .do header ('roma (P2501 to P2508) ... Acepta / Trataria de evitar / Rechazaria') both describe P.25, not the parallel P.24 immigrant block (cols 105-112, same value labels, shipped as _distance); 8 items and resp 1..3 match. validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (8 items, resp sets exact). language=Spanish; translation_source=machine_translation (CIS publishes Estudio 3119 in Spanish only; the _translated columns are English written by IRW; 'personas gitanas' rendered 'Roma people', 'Acepta/ría' 'Accepts/would accept', 'bloque' 'building', 'piso' 'flat', matching _distance and _proximity; issues-page line owed once live). RIGHTS: applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, all CIS survey years); originator is CIS. No register row written. Siblings spain_2015_immigration_rights (in flight this round) and all other spain_2015_immigration_* tables not touched.
public_note: Codes run 1 = Acepta/ría (accepts or would accept the relationship) to 3 = Rechazaría (would reject it); the volunteered 'Depende' (it depends) answer and don't-know/no-answer are stored as missing, removing 6.4-12.3% of respondents per item; p2501's wording follows the CIS questionnaire ('muchas personas gitanas'), whereas CIS's SPSS variable label omits 'muchas'; item text English is IRW machine translation of the Spanish-only CIS questionnaire
